the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

About Us

## Who We Are — Hengshui Zenith Medical

Hengshui Zenith Medical Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer specializing in the production of
hospital beds, home care beds, air mattresses, hospital furniture, and a range of related medical
equipment. Our company is committed to improving the quality of life for patients and the elderly,
offering products that ensure comfort, safety, and reliability.

With a focus on high-quality manufacturing, we strive to meet the ever-evolving needs of the
healthcare industry while adhering to the highest standards of excellence. Our team of experienced
engineers, quality inspectors, and customer service professionals work together to deliver solutions
that healthcare providers and caregivers trust every day.

🏭

### State-of-the-Art Manufacturing

Our modern production facility is equipped with laser cutting machines, robotic welding systems, and
automated spraying lines, ensuring precision and consistency across every product we manufacture.

🔬

### Dedicated R&D Department

Our Research and Development team continuously innovates and enhances our product offerings,
incorporating market feedback and global distributor insights to introduce new, forward-thinking
medical equipment solutions.

🤝

### Long-Term Global Partnerships

We have built strong, lasting partnerships with distributors across Asia, the Middle East, South
America, and beyond — relationships founded on trust, transparency, and mutual growth.

Quality Assurance

## Quality Control & Innovation

At Hengshui Zenith Medical, quality is at the core of everything we do. Our production process
starts with precision in the selection of raw materials and the meticulous welding of product
structures. We take stringent measures to ensure the superior finish of each product, including
rigorous quality checks on spraying processes.

🔩

### Raw Material Selection

Every product begins with rigorously vetted raw materials. We source only premium-grade steel,
fabrics, and components that meet our strict internal specifications.

🤖

### Robotic Welding Systems

Our advanced robotic welding systems deliver consistent, high-precision welds on every product
frame, eliminating human error and ensuring structural integrity.

🔪

### Laser Cutting Technology

Laser cutting machines enable us to achieve micron-level accuracy in component fabrication, reducing
waste and ensuring perfect fit and finish across all product lines.

🎨

### Spraying & Surface Finish

Our automated spraying process applies uniform, durable coatings to all metal surfaces, with
multi-stage inspection checkpoints ensuring a flawless, corrosion-resistant finish.

Certifications & Standards

## Internationally Recognized Certifications

Hengshui Zenith Medical's commitment to quality is reflected in our compliance with international
standards. Each product undergoes thorough testing and inspection before it reaches our customers,
guaranteeing that it meets both functional and safety requirements.

🏅

### ISO 9001:2015

Our ISO 9001:2015 certification demonstrates our commitment to a robust Quality Management System,
ensuring consistent product quality, process efficiency, and continuous improvement across all
operations.

⚕️

### EN ISO 13485:2016

The EN ISO 13485:2016 certification confirms that our Quality Management System meets the specific
regulatory requirements for medical device manufacturers, ensuring patient safety and product
reliability.

🔍

### Rigorous Product Testing

Every product undergoes comprehensive functional testing, load testing, durability assessments, and
safety inspections before shipment, ensuring that each unit delivered to our customers performs
flawlessly.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

About Us

## Who We Are — Hengshui Zenith Medical

Hengshui Zenith Medical Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer specializing in the production of
hospital beds, home care beds, air mattresses, hospital furniture, and a range of related medical
equipment. Our company is committed to improving the quality of life for patients and the elderly,
offering products that ensure comfort, safety, and reliability.

With a focus on high-quality manufacturing, we strive to meet the ever-evolving needs of the
healthcare industry while adhering to the highest standards of excellence. Our team of experienced
engineers, quality inspectors, and customer service professionals work together to deliver solutions
that healthcare providers and caregivers trust every day.

🏭

### State-of-the-Art Manufacturing

Our modern production facility is equipped with laser cutting machines, robotic welding systems, and
automated spraying lines, ensuring precision and consistency across every product we manufacture.

🔬

### Dedicated R&D Department

Our Research and Development team continuously innovates and enhances our product offerings,
incorporating market feedback and global distributor insights to introduce new, forward-thinking
medical equipment solutions.

🤝

### Long-Term Global Partnerships

We have built strong, lasting partnerships with distributors across Asia, the Middle East, South
America, and beyond — relationships founded on trust, transparency, and mutual growth.

Quality Assurance

## Quality Control & Innovation

At Hengshui Zenith Medical, quality is at the core of everything we do. Our production process
starts with precision in the selection of raw materials and the meticulous welding of product
structures. We take stringent measures to ensure the superior finish of each product, including
rigorous quality checks on spraying processes.

🔩

### Raw Material Selection

Every product begins with rigorously vetted raw materials. We source only premium-grade steel,
fabrics, and components that meet our strict internal specifications.

🤖

### Robotic Welding Systems

Our advanced robotic welding systems deliver consistent, high-precision welds on every product
frame, eliminating human error and ensuring structural integrity.

🔪

### Laser Cutting Technology

Laser cutting machines enable us to achieve micron-level accuracy in component fabrication, reducing
waste and ensuring perfect fit and finish across all product lines.

🎨

### Spraying & Surface Finish

Our automated spraying process applies uniform, durable coatings to all metal surfaces, with
multi-stage inspection checkpoints ensuring a flawless, corrosion-resistant finish.

Certifications & Standards

## Internationally Recognized Certifications

Hengshui Zenith Medical's commitment to quality is reflected in our compliance with international
standards. Each product undergoes thorough testing and inspection before it reaches our customers,
guaranteeing that it meets both functional and safety requirements.

🏅

### ISO 9001:2015

Our ISO 9001:2015 certification demonstrates our commitment to a robust Quality Management System,
ensuring consistent product quality, process efficiency, and continuous improvement across all
operations.

⚕️

### EN ISO 13485:2016

The EN ISO 13485:2016 certification confirms that our Quality Management System meets the specific
regulatory requirements for medical device manufacturers, ensuring patient safety and product
reliability.

🔍

### Rigorous Product Testing

Every product undergoes comprehensive functional testing, load testing, durability assessments, and
safety inspections before shipment, ensuring that each unit delivered to our customers performs
flawlessly.

### FDA + CMS RAPID Pathway: What Biomed Departments Should Expect From Faster Breakthrough-Device
### Coverage

For years the gap between FDA market authorization and a Medicare national or local coverage
determination has meant that a device could be legally marketed long before hospitals had a reliable
reimbursement path for it. Efforts to close that gap build directly on the FDA's Breakthrough
Devices Program and on CMS coverage frameworks such as Transitional Coverage for Emerging
Technologies (TCET), both of which are aimed at moving designated devices through review and
coverage decisions on a more predictable, parallel timeline rather than the traditional sequential
one.

For a Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) department, faster coverage does not simply mean
equipment arrives sooner — it compresses the window you have to complete incoming inspection, safety
and electrical testing, network and cybersecurity vetting, and integration into the CMMS before the
device is in clinical use. Departments should expect tighter on-boarding cycles, more emphasis on
coverage-with-evidence-development style data capture, and closer coordination with supply chain,
clinical engineering, and revenue-cycle teams so that a device authorized under a breakthrough
designation is fully commissioned and documented before its first billed procedure.

Practically, this is a documentation and readiness story. Surveyors from The Joint Commission and
CMS continue to expect that every device in service has a complete equipment history, a documented
risk-based maintenance strategy, and evidence of staff training. Build your acceptance-testing
checklist and your alternative-equipment-maintenance justification now, so that a newly covered
breakthrough device does not enter the patient-care environment ahead of the records that prove it

### NFPA 99 (2026 Edition): Tighter Category 1 Verification Intervals, New Wet-Location
### Documentation

NFPA 99, Health Care Facilities Code, is the backbone document behind how hospitals classify and
maintain medical gas and vacuum systems, electrical distribution, and other risk-based building
systems. Its Category 1 through Category 4 framework ties the rigor of testing and maintenance to
the clinical consequence of failure — a Category 1 system is one whose failure is likely to cause
major injury or death, which is why piped medical gas and isolated power in wet procedure locations
receive the most scrutiny.

Whenever a new edition tightens verification intervals or adds documentation requirements, the real
work lands on hospital electricians, facilities engineers, and biomeds who have to translate code
language into concrete preventive-maintenance tasks and CMMS records. For piped gas systems that
means confirming source alarms, zone valves, and outlet performance on schedule; for isolated power
panels in wet procedure locations it means line isolation monitor (LIM) testing and a clear
accountability trail showing who verified each panel and when.

# GUANGDONG DAYANG MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD

Guangdong Dayang Medical Technology Co.,Ltd, founded in 2009, is a leading manufacturer in design,
production and sales of medical equipments. It owns two major brands, DAYANG and DAHAO. Its main
products are wholesale custom electric wheelchairs, manual wheelchairs, sport wheelchairs, commodes,
walkers, hospital beds, walking sticks etc. The electric wheelchair manufacturer locates in Foshan,
hinterland of Guangdong-HK-Macao Greater Bay Area. It has two R&D and production bases. Headquarter
is in Changhongling Industrial Park, Nanhai District. The subsidiary Foshan Dahoo Medical Technology
Co., Ltd., covering a land area of over 80000 square meters and specializing in electric wheelchairs
development and production, is located in Leping Industrial Park, one of the fifty-three national
high-tech development zone in China.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## Yarım Asırlık Tecrübe, Hijyenik Çözümlerle Buluştu

**RENASAN A.Ş.**, 1967 yılında Ankara’da mürekkepli şerit üretimi ile faaliyetlerine başlamış ve
yıllar içinde üretim tecrübesini geliştirerek Türkiye’nin köklü üreticilerinden biri haline
gelmiştir.

2000’li yıllarla birlikte sağlık ve hijyen sektörüne yönelen firmamız, **tek kullanımlık hijyen
ürünleri üretimi** alanında güçlü bir konuma ulaşmıştır. Yarım asrı aşan üretim deneyimimiz
sayesinde hem yurt içi hem de uluslararası pazarlarda güvenilir bir marka olarak faaliyet
göstermekteyiz.

Muayene masa örtülerinden **dental hasta önlüklerine**, **antiseptik mendillerden** **ultrason jel
ürünlerine** kadar uzanan geniş ürün yelpazemiz; sağlık ve hijyen standartlarına uygun olarak modern
üretim tesislerimizde üretilmektedir.

Müşteri ihtiyaçlarına özel üretim çözümleri, yüksek kalite standartları ve sürdürülebilir üretim
anlayışı ile hijyen sektöründe yenilikçi çözümler sunmaya devam ediyoruz.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.

  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.

  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

Excellence**

### FDA + CMS RAPID Pathway: What Biomed Departments Should Expect From Faster Breakthrough-Device
### Coverage

For years the gap between FDA market authorization and a Medicare national or local coverage
determination has meant that a device could be legally marketed long before hospitals had a reliable
reimbursement path for it. Efforts to close that gap build directly on the FDA's Breakthrough
Devices Program and on CMS coverage frameworks such as Transitional Coverage for Emerging
Technologies (TCET), both of which are aimed at moving designated devices through review and
coverage decisions on a more predictable, parallel timeline rather than the traditional sequential
one.

For a Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) department, faster coverage does not simply mean
equipment arrives sooner — it compresses the window you have to complete incoming inspection, safety
and electrical testing, network and cybersecurity vetting, and integration into the CMMS before the
device is in clinical use. Departments should expect tighter on-boarding cycles, more emphasis on
coverage-with-evidence-development style data capture, and closer coordination with supply chain,

### FDA + CMS RAPID Pathway: What Biomed Departments Should Expect From Faster Breakthrough-Device
### Coverage

For years the gap between FDA market authorization and a Medicare national or local coverage
determination has meant that a device could be legally marketed long before hospitals had a reliable
reimbursement path for it. Efforts to close that gap build directly on the FDA's Breakthrough
Devices Program and on CMS coverage frameworks such as Transitional Coverage for Emerging
Technologies (TCET), both of which are aimed at moving designated devices through review and
coverage decisions on a more predictable, parallel timeline rather than the traditional sequential
one.

For a Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) department, faster coverage does not simply mean
equipment arrives sooner — it compresses the window you have to complete incoming inspection, safety
and electrical testing, network and cybersecurity vetting, and integration into the CMMS before the
device is in clinical use. Departments should expect tighter on-boarding cycles, more emphasis on
coverage-with-evidence-development style data capture, and closer coordination with supply chain,
clinical engineering, and revenue-cycle teams so that a device authorized under a breakthrough
designation is fully commissioned and documented before its first billed procedure.

Practically, this is a documentation and readiness story. Surveyors from The Joint Commission and
CMS continue to expect that every device in service has a complete equipment history, a documented
risk-based maintenance strategy, and evidence of staff training. Build your acceptance-testing
checklist and your alternative-equipment-maintenance justification now, so that a newly covered
breakthrough device does not enter the patient-care environment ahead of the records that prove it
is safe and properly maintained.

Faster device coverage lands on top of a shifting accreditation floor. On June 30, 2025 The Joint
Commission announced Accreditation 360, the largest rewrite of its hospital standards in the
program’s history, consolidating the former Environment of Care and Life Safety chapters into a
single Physical Environment chapter that takes effect in 2026 and shifts emphasis from paperwork
volume toward the demonstrated condition of equipment. For biomed departments onboarding newly
covered breakthrough devices, that means clean incoming inspections, documented preventive
maintenance on 100% of the inventory, and service records that survive a leaner but sharper survey.
We build our programs to that bar. See [The Joint Commission][21] and [CMS][22].

Sources: [FDA Breakthrough Devices Program][23]; [CMS TCET][24]; [The Joint Commission][25]

### NFPA 99 (2026 Edition): Tighter Category 1 Verification Intervals, New Wet-Location
### Documentation

NFPA 99, Health Care Facilities Code, is the backbone document behind how hospitals classify and
maintain medical gas and vacuum systems, electrical distribution, and other risk-based building
systems. Its Category 1 through Category 4 framework ties the rigor of testing and maintenance to
the clinical consequence of failure — a Category 1 system is one whose failure is likely to cause
major injury or death, which is why piped medical gas and isolated power in wet procedure locations
receive the most scrutiny.

Whenever a new edition tightens verification intervals or adds documentation requirements, the real
work lands on hospital electricians, facilities engineers, and biomeds who have to translate code
language into concrete preventive-maintenance tasks and CMMS records. For piped gas systems that
means confirming source alarms, zone valves, and outlet performance on schedule; for isolated power
panels in wet procedure locations it means line isolation monitor (LIM) testing and a clear
accountability trail showing who verified each panel and when.

## Frequently Asked Questions

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

A [Safety IV Cannula][61] is a sterile, single-use medical device designed to provide safe and
effective venous access while minimizing the risk of needlestick injuries.

Effective for the implementation of IV therapy, many parts come together to form an [ IV infusion
set ][64]. It consists of a needle, an IV drip and chamber, and a cannula.

### [Hypodermic Syringe][66]

An extra sharp needle instrumental for withdrawing blood from the body, a [ hypodermic syringe][67]
is a thin and hollow tube with a pointed tip.

[[Respiratory-Devices]][68]

### [Respiratory Devices][69]

Patients with [ respiratory ][70]dysfunctions benefit from these tools and devices that provide
support for proper inhalation and exhalation and administration of nasal medicines.

With great elasticity and flexibility, [ medical gloves][73] allow healthcare providers to examine
and diagnose patients efficiently without the fear of getting infected themselves.

[[three way cock ext line]][74]

and medical procedures.

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. How Do I Choose the Right Medical Device Supplier for My Needs?

All you need to do is check the company’s testimonials and reviews given by previous clients and
also if the company has goodwill in the market. Make sure they are complying with rules and
regulations.

2. Are Medical Equipment Always Regulated?

Yes. You must ensure that the chosen company adheres to all regulations so that the tools and
devices are fit to be used for medical purposes.

3. How Do I Know if the Medical Equipment is Right for My Purpose?

You can always consult with a medical equipment wholesaler or a healthcare provider to assess the
product’s clinical relevance. Check the specifications of the item before purchasing it.

4. Are There Varying Factors That Affect the Price of Medical Equipment?

Yes. The features and technologies you get in the particular medical device will have an effect on
the price point. Lars Medicare has a range of high-quality equipment at affordable prices.

5. How Often Should Medical Equipment Be Serviced?

It depends on the healthcare equipment manufacturer’s recommendation. While there are certain things
that are disposable right after single use, other equipment needs to be cleaned and sterilised after
each use.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

### Innovation and research:

means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## Hakkımızda

## Yarım Asırlık Tecrübe, Hijyenik Çözümlerle Buluştu

**RENASAN A.Ş.**, 1967 yılında Ankara’da mürekkepli şerit üretimi ile faaliyetlerine başlamış ve
yıllar içinde üretim tecrübesini geliştirerek Türkiye’nin köklü üreticilerinden biri haline
gelmiştir.

2000’li yıllarla birlikte sağlık ve hijyen sektörüne yönelen firmamız, **tek kullanımlık hijyen
ürünleri üretimi** alanında güçlü bir konuma ulaşmıştır. Yarım asrı aşan üretim deneyimimiz
sayesinde hem yurt içi hem de uluslararası pazarlarda güvenilir bir marka olarak faaliyet
göstermekteyiz.

Muayene masa örtülerinden **dental hasta önlüklerine**, **antiseptik mendillerden** **ultrason jel
ürünlerine** kadar uzanan geniş ürün yelpazemiz; sağlık ve hijyen standartlarına uygun olarak modern
üretim tesislerimizde üretilmektedir.

Müşteri ihtiyaçlarına özel üretim çözümleri, yüksek kalite standartları ve sürdürülebilir üretim
anlayışı ile hijyen sektöründe yenilikçi çözümler sunmaya devam ediyoruz.

## Yarım Asırlık Tecrübe, Hijyenik Çözümlerle Buluştu

**RENASAN A.Ş.**, 1967 yılında Ankara’da mürekkepli şerit üretimi ile faaliyetlerine başlamış ve
yıllar içinde üretim tecrübesini geliştirerek Türkiye’nin köklü üreticilerinden biri haline
gelmiştir.

2000’li yıllarla birlikte sağlık ve hijyen sektörüne yönelen firmamız, **tek kullanımlık hijyen
ürünleri üretimi** alanında güçlü bir konuma ulaşmıştır. Yarım asrı aşan üretim deneyimimiz
sayesinde hem yurt içi hem de uluslararası pazarlarda güvenilir bir marka olarak faaliyet
göstermekteyiz.

Muayene masa örtülerinden **dental hasta önlüklerine**, **antiseptik mendillerden** **ultrason jel
ürünlerine** kadar uzanan geniş ürün yelpazemiz; sağlık ve hijyen standartlarına uygun olarak modern
üretim tesislerimizde üretilmektedir.

Müşteri ihtiyaçlarına özel üretim çözümleri, yüksek kalite standartları ve sürdürülebilir üretim
anlayışı ile hijyen sektöründe yenilikçi çözümler sunmaya devam ediyoruz.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**
